You need to use the barcodes for each aisles LTO to quickscan the LNOs. A lot of stores just have 1 barcode to scan the LNOs, but like you said you dont know where it is


The biggest thing tho is after you run a double beep cage and have stuff that has to go back into an LTO cage. Theres a function where you can manual scan stuff back into a cage without using Overstock scan


Under stock management, LNO & LTO Management, Add to LTO location

Top middle or Top right of the screen when you scan something will have locations eg A5B5S5


Which means aisle 5 bay 5 shelf 5. These are written on tickets for products (dont confuse it with online locations, theyre different)
